description: Creates an order on the Yango Tech platform (POST /b2b/v1/orders/create). You supply the order_id; the same body shape is used by the platform for order updates. All money fields are decimal STRINGS (e.g. "150.00"), never numbers. The response body is not documented upstream and is returned verbatim. After creation, track progress with get_orders_state (get_order does NOT return the state).

cart.description: Shopping cart: items plus totals (all money as decimal strings).

discount.description: Discount amount for the line, decimal string.

price.description: Price per unit as a decimal string, e.g. "150.00".

vat.description: VAT rate/amount for the line as a decimal string, e.g. "20".

client_phone_number.description: Customer phone number in international format.

courier_pin.description: PIN the courier must present on handover.

delivery_address.description: Delivery address: coordinates plus optional structured address and comment.

position.description: Delivery point coordinates {lat, lon} — required inside delivery_address.

delivery_properties.description: Delivery properties: type and optional {start, end} slot.

human_order_id.description: Human-readable order number shown to the customer.

order_id.description: Client-side order id (you choose it; reuse it in the other order tools).

payment_type.description: Payment type. Known values: cash, online, card, apple_pay, loyalty (the list is open-ended).

use_external_logistics.description: true — delivery is handled by external (3PL) logistics instead of the platform.

name: create_order
title: Create an order
